activity.notes: Ptolemy I Soter, formerly Alexander the Great's general and satrap of Egypt, assumed kingship and founded the Ptolemaic Kingdom. ATLAS records his royal phase from 305 to 282 BCE rather than folding his earlier satrapal government into the reign.

sources.title: Faience Sistrum Inscribed with the Name of Ptolemy I — The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum dates Ptolemy I's Ptolemaic royal period to 305–282 BCE.

sources.title: Temple relief of Ptolemy I Soter — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Ptolemy I Soter as ruler in the Ptolemaic period and dates the associated royal production to 305–282 BCE.
